intro: Kalamata Olives are a premium Mediterranean topping available on the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings). These distinctive pitted Greek olives add authentic flavor to any bowl or pita at just 35 calories. Whether building your own creation or customizing from the [full CAVA menu](/), these briny, rich olives deliver classic Mediterranean taste without additional cost.
priceCalories: Kalamata Olives are included with your meal at no extra charge, making them an excellent value addition to any order. At only 35 calories per serving with 0g protein, 2g carbs, and 3g fat, they provide bold flavor without significantly impacting your nutritional totals. This complimentary topping enhances bowls and pitas from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) with authentic Mediterranean character.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Kalamata Olives apart is their authentic Greek heritage and distinctive deep purple color. Unlike standard black olives, Kalamatas offer a wine-like richness and meaty texture that defines Mediterranean cuisine. These pitted olives provide convenience and safety while maintaining their characteristic almond shape and fruity, complex flavor profile that elevates any CAVA creation.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Kalamata Olives contains 35 calories with a macronutrient breakdown of 0g protein, 2g carbohydrates, and 3g fat. The fat content consists primarily of heart-healthy monounsaturated fats characteristic of Mediterranean olives. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how Kalamata Olives fit into your customized meal and explore the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for dietary considerations.
whatsInside: Kalamata Olives contain just one simple ingredient: pitted Kalamata olives. These authentic Greek olives are naturally cured and preserved, maintaining their characteristic deep purple-brown color and meaty texture. The olives are carefully pitted for convenience and safety, allowing you to enjoy their complex flavor without concern. This clean ingredient list reflects CAVA's commitment to quality Mediterranean ingredients.
tasteLike: Kalamata Olives deliver a rich, fruity flavor with wine-like notes and a pleasant brininess. Their taste is more complex and robust than standard black olives, offering a slightly smoky, almost almond-like undertone. The meaty, firm texture provides satisfying substance, while the natural saltiness enhances other ingredients. These olives add authentic Mediterranean depth that complements fresh vegetables and protein choices.
customize: Kalamata Olives pair beautifully across the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) with options like Saffron Basmati Rice or Supergreens. They complement proteins from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) including Grilled Chicken and Spicy Lamb Meatballs. Combine them with Shredded Romaine, Tomato + Onion, and Sumac Cabbage Slaw for a Greek-inspired bowl, or add alongside [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) selections like Tzatziki.
pairsWell: Kalamata Olives pair exceptionally well with Shredded Romaine for a classic Greek salad foundation, and complement Tomato + Onion perfectly for traditional Mediterranean flavor. They enhance Pita Crisps with textural contrast and work beautifully with Sumac Cabbage Slaw for a tangy combination. These olives also pair excellently with feta cheese, cucumber, and red wine vinegar dressing from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings).
healthyChoice: Kalamata Olives are a nutritious choice rich in monounsaturated fats that support heart health and provide antioxidants. At only 35 calories, they deliver satisfying flavor and healthy fats without excessive calories. These olives contain polyphenols and vitamin E, contributing to an anti-inflammatory Mediterranean diet. For those following specific dietary patterns, review the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) for compatible options.
howToOrder: To add Kalamata Olives to your order, start by selecting your base and protein from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) or build your own. When you reach the toppings section, request Kalamata Olives at no additional charge. They work in any bowl, pita, or salad configuration. Visit [CAVA Locations](/locations) to find your nearest restaurant and enjoy this complimentary Mediterranean topping.
vsAlternatives: Compared to standard canned black olives, Kalamata Olives offer superior flavor complexity and meaty texture with only slightly higher calories. While pickled vegetables provide acidity, Kalamatas deliver rich, fruity depth that is uniquely Mediterranean. Unlike heavy toppings that add significant calories, these olives provide authentic taste at just 35 calories. Their inclusion at no extra cost makes them more valuable than premium add-ons.
whoShouldTry: Kalamata Olives are perfect for Mediterranean cuisine enthusiasts seeking authentic Greek flavors in their CAVA bowls. Health-conscious diners appreciate the heart-healthy fats and low calorie count. Those building Greek-inspired combinations with feta, cucumber, and tomatoes should definitely include them. Olive lovers seeking upgrade from standard varieties and anyone wanting to add satisfying richness without extra cost will enjoy this premium topping.
worthTrying: Kalamata Olives are absolutely worth trying for their authentic Mediterranean flavor and excellent nutritional profile at zero additional cost. These premium Greek olives transform ordinary bowls into restaurant-quality Mediterranean experiences with just 35 calories. Their complex, wine-like flavor and meaty texture provide satisfaction that standard toppings cannot match. As a complimentary inclusion, they offer outstanding value and culinary authenticity.
